fieldValues.title: An essay is published from the editor; the site renders it from the records
fieldValues.move: Publish in the editor marks a finished essay as published. Essays live in the muSrs repository (or are synced into it), and the site's existing build step (publish-musrs.mjs, which already renders problems and routines from muSrs records) renders each published essay's composition into a page. The records stay the single source; the page is a projection, so a later edit republishes the same essay rather than a copy.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Distribution beyond the site (newsletters, social), scheduling, and editing on the site itself. Where essays are written today, if not in muSrs, until they are moved or synced.
fieldValues.falsifier: A published essay on the site differs from its record after the next build, or publishing needs a step outside the editor and the normal site build.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: publish essays from where they are written
fieldValues.return_when: When the first essay has gone from the editor to the site this way and the owner has said whether publishing felt like one act.
